'''2000 DecipherCon Jabba's Palace Sealed Deck (7 October)''' was a Star Wars CCG sealed deck held in Kissimmee, Florida on 7 October 2000. It is known from Paul Myers's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1312">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-10-09-worlds-clints-penis-game-4-trs-in-1d1312/ worlds-clints-penis-game-4-trs-in-1], DeckTech (Paul "lbmyers1" Myers, 9 October 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-10-09-worlds-clints-penis-game-4-trs-in-1d1312/ GitHub Pages].</ref> It was played alongside the [[DecipherCon 2000]].

* '''Date:''' 7 October 2000
* '''Site:''' Kissimmee, Florida
* '''Format:''' [[Jabba's Palace Sealed Deck (format)]]
